info.title: Fluyo mobile-facing API contract
info.description: Provider-neutral schemas for implemented Fluyo endpoints. Inclusion does not imply public mobile availability.

400.description: Invalid request, activity identifier, or idempotency key

Retry-After.description: Positive integer number of seconds before a new-key retry.

CorrelationId.description: Opaque request correlation identifier. The current server does not enforce a maximum length. Never display it as a product error.

retryPolicy.safeReads: Retry with bounded exponential backoff and cancellation.
retryPolicy.writes: Retry only an ambiguous attempt with the same UUID v4 Idempotency-Key. A new logical attempt uses a new key.
retryPolicy.rateLimit: Honor positive integer Retry-After seconds. Stored replay and conflict checks precede throttling.

excluded: Stripe Checkout and Customer Portal are web-only.
Learning export and deletion have internal hooks but no HTTP endpoint.
Native callback, telemetry, RevenueCat, tester enrollment, and campaign endpoints do not exist.
